summary: The blueprint is broadly plausible for healthy human pancreas but needs targeted immune, stromal, and rare endocrine refinements before it is publishable unchanged.

issues.description: The only myeloid axis is macrophage-skewed and does not clearly represent dendritic or antigen-presenting myeloid populations expected in healthy human pancreas atlases.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a dendritic/APC-focused module and axis if supported by the cited pancreas atlas literature, or broaden the myeloid design to distinguish macrophage from DC-like antigen-presenting cells. Candidate markers to evaluate include FCER1A, CD1C, CLEC10A, CLEC9A, XCR1, LILRA4, and HLA class II genes.

issues.description: The t_nk_lymphocyte module is T-cell focused while NK cells already have a separate nk_cell axis, so the current name implies a mixed T/NK population and weakens interpretability.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename/refocus t_nk_lymphocyte as a T-cell module/axis, or redesign the lymphocyte axes around an explicit pan T/NK gate plus separate T and NK refinements. The simpler fix is to make it t_cell and keep nk_cell separate.

issues.description: The rare epsilon/ghrelin cell module includes strong markers such as GHRL and MBOAT4 but also less canonical or potentially non-pancreas-enter endocrine/metabolic genes such as MLN, FFAR3, CD320, and ACSL1.
issues.suggested_fix: Tighten the epsilon module against human pancreas/islet evidence. Keep high-confidence ghrelin-cell markers and replace weak entries with better-supported epsilon markers, or use a shorter high-confidence module rather than padding it.

issues.description: The stromal axis mainly scores broad collagen/ECM fibroblast activation and may under-resolve resident pancreatic stellate/fibroblast identity versus activated ECM or myofibroblast-like state.
issues.suggested_fix: Split the stromal design into quiescent stellate/fibroblast and activated ECM/myofibroblast axes if literature-supported, or rebalance the current module so it is clearly a resident stellate/fibroblast identity axis rather than mostly an ECM activation score.

out_of_scope: I did not re-verify paper or atlas DOI metadata; citation verification is outside this discriminator pass.
